_about: Breadth set r7, JavaScript (ARB-166), frozen before any clone or scan. JavaScript applications and services drawn from GitHub topics ['self-hosted', 'web-application', 'webapp', 'dashboard', 'cms', 'api-server', 'rest-api', 'backend', 'monitoring', 'automation', 'bot', 'discord-bot', 'telegram-bot', 'chatbot', 'scraper', 'crawler', 'cli', 'proxy', 'whatsapp-bot', 'electron-app', 'home-automation', 'game-server', 'chat', 'saas', 'workflow', 'media-server', 'mcp-server'], each with >= 300 stars, pushed since 2026-08-26, not archived/fork/template, an OSI licence, JavaScript >= 60% of bytes, TypeScript < 10% of bytes, size <= 400000 KB, a .github/workflows directory, no path Windows cannot check out, a description and topics that do not name a library/SDK/plugin/component kit/tutorial/boilerplate/list, a file showing it is deployed or installed as an application (Dockerfile or compose file, Procfile, fly.toml/render.yaml, systemd unit, electron-builder/forge/tauri config, platformio.ini/sdkconfig, debian/control, or man pages; some real CLIs lack all of these and are lost), and not named anywhere in Arbiter's tools, packs, docs or fixtures (held-out sets, gold repos, ground-truth sources, every other breadth manifest). Chosen from metadata and file names only; candidates shuffled with seed 20261026, then split with seed 20261027 into 'dev' (17: rule fixes may read these) and 'heldout' (measurement only, never used for tuning). Each repo is pinned to its default-branch HEAD at freeze time.

js-portracker.description: An open source, self-hosted, real-time port monitoring and discovery tool.

js-phoenixanalytics.description: 📊 Plug and play analytics for Phoenix applications.

js-camofox-browser.description: Stealth headless browser for AI agents — bypass Cloudflare, bot detection, and anti-scraping. Drop-in Puppeteer/Playwright replacement.

js-fredy.description: ❤️ Fredy - [F]ind [R]eal [E]state [D]amn Eas[y] - Fredy keeps searching for new apartments, houses, and flats in Europe on platforms like ImmoScout24, Immowelt, eBay Kleinanzeigen and instantly delivers the results to you via Slack, Telegram, Email, Discord or ntfy, so you can focus on the more important things in life ;)

js-teamclaude.description: Multi-account proxy for Claude Code and Codex: pools Claude Max, ChatGPT/Codex, API-key and third-party backend accounts, and rotates on quota

js-discord-bot.description: Discord Bot with over 400 commands and made for large servers

js-pullmd.description: Self-hosted URL- and file-to-Markdown service for humans and AI agents - web pages, documents, images, audio, YouTube. PWA + REST + MCP + Claude Code skill, Reddit-aware, refreshable share links.

js-silva-md-bot.description: Silva MD Bot is a smart tool that enhances your WhatsApp experience by automating interactions and offering useful features like motivation, media downloads, and interactive polls.

js-rsc-harness.description: Your agent invents things because it has no memory, and can't touch your database because it has no arms. rsc is the meta-harness that gives it both, plus the trade to know the job and the reflexes to not break your repo. For Claude Code, Codex and 15 more.

js-bot.description: The most popular open-source and self-hosted ticket management bot for Discord - a free alternative to the premium and white-label plans of other popular ticketing bots.

js-steam-comment-service-bot.description: 📡 The most advanced Steam Account Manager Bot with mass coordinated comments/likes/favs/follows and plugin support

js-helicalinsight.description: Free, open source BI platform with AI conversational analytics (BYO-LLM), pixel-perfect paginated reports, interactive dashboards, SSO, embedding, multi-tenancy & row-level security. Every feature free in Community Edition. Self-hosted, Docker-ready

js-tannergabriel-discord-bot.description: Simple discord bot to play music and manage your server

js-goploader.description: Easy file sharing with server-side encryption, curl/httpie/wget compliant

js-free-games-claimer.description: Automatically claims free games and DLCs on the Epic Games Store, Amazon Prime Gaming and GOG.

js-brightdata-mcp.description: A powerful Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides an all-in-one solution for public web access.

js-echo-server.description: REST Server Tests (Echo-Server) API / Docker / Kubernetes / Helm

js-phantomas.description: Headless Chromium-based web performance metrics collector and monitoring tool

js-noisedash.description: Self-hostable web tool for generating ambient noises

js-mirotalkc2c.description: 📹 Open-source, self-hosted WebRTC 1-to-1 video calling for private real-time communication. Build secure browser-based consultations, coaching, support, telehealth, and other video call experiences with peer-to-peer communication and screen sharing.

js-titanbot.description: A powerful, all-in-one Discord assistant built for every server.

js-single-file-cli.description: CLI tool for saving a faithful copy of a complete web page in a single HTML file (based on SingleFile)

js-saltgui.description: A web interface for managing SaltStack based infrastructure.

js-homepage.description: A highly customizable homepage (or startpage / application dashboard) with Docker and service API integrations.

js-fireshare.description: Self host your media and share with unique links

js-codexmate.description: One dashboard for all your local AI coding agents. Switch providers, manage sessions, and orchestrate tasks across Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, CodeBuddy Code, Pi, OpenCode, KiloCode, and OpenClaw. Zero cloud, local-first control plane.

js-mineflayer.description: Create Minecraft bots with a powerful, stable, and high level JavaScript API.

js-lynkr.description: Streamline your workflow with Lynkr, a CLI tool that acts as an HTTP proxy for efficient code interactions using Claude Code CLI.

js-react-glass-keep.description: Glass Keep is Keep Notes alternative using Glass design.  Docker Server, Tauri Clients and PWA

js-homegenie.description: HomeGenie: The Programmable Intelligence with 100% Local Agentic AI.
